subject: chemistry
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Write the Lewis dot structure of CO₂. What is its molecular shape?
questions.solution:
Carbon (4 valence e⁻) forms double bonds with each oxygen (6 valence e⁻ each).

Lewis structure: O=C=O

Using VSEPR: 2 bonding pairs, 0 lone pairs on C → **Linear** geometry, bond angle 180°.
questions.knowledgeNote: CO₂ is linear and non-polar despite having polar C=O bonds due to symmetry.
questions.answer: **Lewis dot structure of CO₂:** O=C=O — each oxygen shares **two electron pairs** with the carbon (two double bonds), giving carbon 8 electrons and each oxygen 8; two lone pairs remain on each oxygen. (In dots: :Ö=C=Ö: with two lone pairs on each O.) **Molecular shape:** the central carbon has **two electron domains** (the two double bonds), no lone pairs ⟹ sp hybridisation, bond angle 180° ⟹ **linear**. **Deep point:** the double bonds count as one domain each in VSEPR — the shape question is answered by counting domains, not bonds.
